description.value: Pizza64 is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 2010 that blends classic pizza with Indian-inspired flavours, offering specialty, signature, and gourmet pies including Butter Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, and Shahi Paneer alongside traditional options. With 20+ locations across British Columbia, this Surrey location sits on 64 Avenue and is part of a fast-growing family-owned franchise. Touring cyclists will find a wide menu suited to varied tastes, with online ordering available for quick pickup.
